stem: What was one reason James K. Polk won the presidential election of 1844?

options.label: F
options.text: He was against removing American Indians from their native lands.

options.label: G
options.text: He favored the policy of popular sovereignty in the Kansas and Nebraska territories.

options.label: H
options.text: He was committed to fulfilling the goals of Manifest Destiny.

options.label: J
options.text: He opposed the extension of slavery west of the Mississippi River.
